title: everyday parts, a sixth round: a nut, a bolt, a hinge leaf, a spoked wheel, a bottle, a ribbed bracket, a box lip, a notched knob

cases.name: c001
cases.description: a hex nut: a hexagon (corners 8 from its middle) extruded 6 with a hole (radius 3), the hole's edges chamfered 0.5 and the corners' tops cut by a cone at 30° from radius 7.2

cases.name: c002
cases.description: a bolt: a shaft (radius 3, 20 long) revolved, a hexagonal head (corners 6 from its middle) 4 tall added on its top, the tip's edge chamfered 0.5

cases.name: c003
cases.description: a hinge leaf: a 40 × 20 × 2 plate with a knuckle (radius 3, 10 long, its axis along x at y = 0, z = 1) patterned once at 20, a pin hole (radius 1.2) through both, the plate's far corners filleted 4

cases.name: c004
cases.description: a spoked wheel: a disc (radius 30, 6 thick) with a hub hole (radius 5), a window between radii 10 and 24 across 50° patterned five times round it, the rim's edges filleted 1

cases.name: c005
cases.description: a bottle: circles of radius 15 at z = 0 and z = 40 and of radius 6 at z = 55 lofted, a neck (radius 6) on to z = 65 added, shelled 1.2 open at the neck

cases.name: c006
cases.description: an L bracket (a 40 × 30 × 4 base, a 4 thick wall 20 up its x = 0 edge) with ribs (3 thick) in its corner at y = 6 and y = 24 and a hole (radius 3) in its base between them

cases.name: c007
cases.description: a 40 × 30 × 20 box shelled 2 open at its top, a lip 1 wide and 3 tall on the inner half of its walls' top

cases.name: c008
cases.description: a knob: a cylinder (radius 10, 8 tall) with a notch (radius 1.5, centred on its side) patterned 12 times round it, its top's edges filleted 0.5
